properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key used for HMAC-SHA signing and validation of JWT tokens.

properties.name: jwt.expiration-ms
properties.description: Expiration duration in milliseconds for generated JWT tokens.

properties.name: telegram.bot.enabled
properties.description: Master switch to enable or disable automated Telegram bot notifications.

properties.name: telegram.bot.token
properties.description: HTTP API authentication token provided by @BotFather for the MMS Telegram bot.

properties.name: telegram.bot.default-chat-id
properties.description: Default administrator Telegram Chat ID for administrative alerts and fallback test delivery.

properties.name: telegram.reminder.default-minutes
properties.description: Default advance reminder lead time in minutes before meeting start time.

properties.name: mail.enabled
properties.description: Master switch to enable or disable automated email notifications with iCalendar attachments.

properties.name: mail.from
properties.description: Default sender email address used for outbound meeting invitation and cancellation emails.
